limitation: Actual Linux candidate inference under a hard 2 GiB/no-swap/two-CPU cap. Weights are copied inside the cgroup to charge their page cache. The goal profile's two OCR child checks run outside that model cgroup, not inside an app memory cap. This is not EC2 joint app/worker/database/voice, a held-out quality evaluation, or production service-account acceptance.
